what: Cell-level data: G x cell state
title: Getting started with scHINT
text: geno donor x SNP dosage matrix cis-SNPs gene. default one GRM built SNPs. context cell-state variable genetic effect may depend (numeric = continuous, factor/character = categorical); covariates enter main effects. G - genetic variance independent cell state. GxC - genetic variance changes along context (state). G_total - G + GxC; - donor effect genetic; context, covariate - main effects. per-component table fit$coefficients. Variance components scale standardized expression, fractions variance. gene without genotype--state effects:
code: fit <- schint_cell(ex$cell, y = "GENE_A", id = "donor", geno = ex$geno,                    context = "state",                    covariates = c("pc1", "pc2", "age", "sex", "batch", "subtype"),                    jackknife = TRUE) fit #> scHINT model: 12000 observations, 400 donors, 1 GRM #>  #> Variance components (fraction of Var(y)): #>             term variance fraction      se se_fraction #>                G 0.205000 0.205000 0.04490     0.04490 #>              GxC 0.163000 0.163000 0.04200     0.04200 #>          G_total 0.369000 0.369000 0.06240     0.06240 #>                I 0.076700 0.076700 0.03480     0.03480 #>          context 0.000348 0.000348 0.00312     0.00312 #>        covariate 0.069600 0.069600 0.01440     0.01440 #>  total_explained 0.515000 0.515000 0.06190     0.06190 #>  #> Standard errors: jackknife over 400 donor blocks schint_cell(ex$cell, "GENE_B", "donor", geno = ex$geno, context = "state")$summary #>              term      variance      fraction #> 1               G  0.2431935652  0.2431935652 #> 2             GxC -0.0008234294 -0.0008234294 #> 3         G_total  0.2423701358  0.2423701358 #> 4               I  0.1077121143  0.1077121143 #> 5         context  0.0064094800  0.0064094800 #> 6 total_explained  0.3564917301  0.3564917301

title: Getting started with scHINT
text: schint_pert() replaces genetic kernel “perturbation”. Several genes fitted interaction can cell state, cell type, . Use perturb_group = "perturb_group" estimate separate components groups perturbations.
code: data(schint_pert_example) fp <- schint_pert(schint_pert_example, y = c("GENE_A", "GENE_B", "GENE_C"),                   perturb = "perturb", context = c("state", "celltype"),                   covariates = c("pc1", "pc2"), control = "NT") fp$summary[fp$summary$term %in% c("P", "PxC:state", "PxC:celltype"), ] #>            gene         term      variance      fraction #> GENE_A.1 GENE_A            P  0.0272190898  0.0272190898 #> GENE_A.4 GENE_A    PxC:state  0.0507430857  0.0507430857 #> GENE_A.5 GENE_A PxC:celltype  0.0110774848  0.0110774848 #> GENE_B.1 GENE_B            P  0.0435317075  0.0435317075 #> GENE_B.4 GENE_B    PxC:state -0.0027662529 -0.0027662529 #> GENE_B.5 GENE_B PxC:celltype  0.0272631582  0.0272631582 #> GENE_C.1 GENE_C            P  0.0665561848  0.0665561848 #> GENE_C.4 GENE_C    PxC:state  0.0009753755  0.0009753755 #> GENE_C.5 GENE_C PxC:celltype  0.0069372804  0.0069372804

title: Getting started with scHINT
text: Genotypes cis window one gene (read_plink() + select_cis_snps()), donors x SNPs matrix whose row names match donor column expression table. One row per cell (donor x cell type) expression gene, donor ID, context variable(s) covariates. Call schint_cell() / schint_sample() per gene. Standard errors use delete-donor (n_blocks blocks donors) jackknife.

title: Heritability of Gene Expression Across Cell States and Cell Types
text: Common options: geno (dosage matrix cis SNPs) grm (pre-computed GRM(s)); n_grm / grm_by split SNPs several GRMs (default: one GRM cis-SNPs); covariates; jackknife = TRUE delete-donor(-block) standard errors.
code: library(scHINT) data(schint_example) ex <- schint_example  # cell level: G x continuous cell state, 3 GRMs split by MAF, jackknife SEs fit <- schint_cell(ex$cell, y = "GENE_A", id = "donor", geno = ex$geno,                    n_grm = 3, grm_by = "maf",                    context = "state", covariates = c("pc1", "pc2", "age", "sex", "batch"),                    jackknife = TRUE) fit fit$coefficients  # sample level: G x cell type, pre-computed GRM fit2 <- schint_sample(ex$sample, y = "GENE_A", id = "donor", celltype = "celltype",                       grm = make_grm(ex$geno), covariates = c("age", "sex")) data(schint_pert_example) schint_pert(schint_pert_example, y = c("GENE_A", "GENE_B"), perturb = "perturb",             context = c("state", "celltype"), covariates = c("pc1", "pc2"),             control = "NT", jackknife = TRUE)

title: Cell-level GxCell-State heritability model — schint_cell
text: data Data frame one row per cell. y Name (numeric) expression column. id Name donor ID column. IDs must match row names `geno`/`grm`. geno Genotypes (cis) SNPs: donors x SNPs dosage matrix row names, list matrices (one GRM ). Give either `geno` `grm`. grm pre-computed donor x donor GRM donor IDs dimnames, (named) list GRMs multi-GRM model. n_grm Number GRMs build single `geno` matrix (default `1` = one GRM SNPs). Values > 1 split SNPs [split_snps()]. grm_by split SNPs `n_grm > 1`: `"maf"`, `"position"` `"random"`. context Character vector column names used cell context interacts genetics. Numeric columns continuous contexts (e.g. pseudotime PC); factor/character columns categorical. `NULL` fits model without genotype--context terms. covariates Character vector covariates (main effects ). Variables also listed `context` duplicated. cat_mode categorical variables `context`: `"pooled"` fits one shared component (pairs level) `"per_level"` fits one per level. ind_effect Include shared-donor component `` (default `TRUE`). context_main Include main-effect components context variable (default `TRUE`). jackknife `TRUE`, delete-donor-block jackknife standard errors. n_blocks Number jackknife blocks donors (default: one per donor). scale_y, scale_x Standardize `y` / continuous context covariates (default `TRUE`). seed Seed assigning donors jackknife blocks.

text: perturb-seq analogue [schint_cell()]: donor/genotype kernel replaced "perturbation" (cells carrying perturbation correlated, cells different perturbations ). Haseman-Elston regression pairs cells partitions variance gene perturbation component `P`, perturbation--context component `P x context` (context = continuous cell state /categorical cell type), context main effects covariates.

title: Perturbation heritability with cell-state or cell-type interaction — schint_pert
text: data Data frame one row per cell. y Character vector expression column(s) (one per gene). perturb Name column holding perturbation (target) cell. context Column name(s) cell context interacting perturbation: numeric = cell state, factor/character = cell type. `NULL` interaction. covariates covariates (main effects ). perturb_group Optional: column name giving perturbation group perturbation, named list perturbation vectors. group gets `P` `P x context` components. control Perturbation labels drop (e.g. non-targeting controls). `NA` `""` always dropped. min_cells Minimum cells per perturbation (perturbations fewer dropped). cat_mode categorical variables `context`: `"pooled"` fits one shared component (pairs level) `"per_level"` fits one per level. context_main Include main-effect components context variable (default `TRUE`). jackknife Delete-perturbation-block jackknife standard errors. n_blocks Number jackknife blocks perturbations (default one per perturbation). scale_y, scale_x Standardize `y` / continuous context covariates (default `TRUE`). seed Seed assigning donors jackknife blocks.
